test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three segments of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the option that contains the error. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

__Although there is no proven data__, the __Centre for Policy Research estimate__ that __India has the largest stock__ of iron ore in the world.

options.text: Although there is no proven data,

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the verb agreement. **"Centre for Policy Research" **is a singular noun and should be followed by the singular verb **"estimates"** instead of the plural verb **"estimate."**
 
• Ensuring subject-verb agreement is crucial for grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Although there is no proven data, the **Centre for Policy Research **estimates that India has the largest stock of iron ore in the world."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Although there is no proven data," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 2.
 
• **Option 4: "India has the largest stock,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
